title: While You Wait for Someone
core_idea: Waiting for a soul connection does not have to mean putting life on hold; living fully now is worthwhile in itself, whoever does or does not arrive.
text: Some people spend years waiting for one particular person, as if real life will begin the day they finally meet. Many traditions hold the idea that certain souls are drawn together. Maybe that is true, and maybe it is simply a beautiful hope. Either way, your life is not a waiting room. The walks you take, the friends you laugh with, the things you are learning to love, they all count now, not only later. And if someone does arrive one day, they will meet a person who has been living, not just waiting. That is not a trick to attract anyone. It is simply a kinder way to spend the years that are already yours.
description: A calm reflection on the soulmate idea, and on living fully now instead of putting life on hold.
